notes.title: Thank YOU for playing!
notes.notes:
[h2] 🙏
[/h2]

Internally, we often referred to Phoenix Springs as an experiment. We know it asks a lot of the player. It’s not for everyone. It’s not straightforward. It does things that maybe shouldn’t be done. Which is why it means so much to see that it resonates with some of you. 

Your words have been incredible. I mean...

[quote]“A sleek, dreamlike noir that'll never give it to you straight. It's a captivating work, with mysteries I still feel desperate to solve.[/quote]

[quote]“Beautiful, intriguing, an exploration on memory and perhaps hubris of wanting to never let go. Go in without expectations, with patience, and take the time to listen.”[/quote]

[quote]“Indescribable, absolutely nothing like it. Played it in one sitting and i'll never ever be able to forget it."[/quote]

[quote]“Beautiful and captivating art style, consistently compelling prose, incredible voice work. A remarkable work from end to end, deserving of replays and a lifetime of contemplation”[/quote]

[quote]“Frankly, the aftertaste is similar to that of finishing a great novel. This relatively short piece of art channels favorite themes of Kazuo Ishiguro, Don DeLillo, and even, to some extent, Italo Calvino.”[/quote]

[quote]“By the time the credits rolled, I felt further than ever from knowing the truth; but nor did I feel entitled to it.”[/quote]

So thanks again for playing, losing yourself and, more importantly, taking the time to think about our little experiment. 

Calligram x

notes.title: Phoenix Springs is Playable on Steam Deck
notes.notes:
We're big fans of the Steam Deck here at Calligram. 
So it is our great pleasure to announce that Phoenix Springs is playable on the handheld console!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43112592/f4289c12d924af0306fec3742a046d3c68be437a.png[/img]

However, please note that it's not fully compatible yet!

Here's how it works:

• Phoenix Springs is still a point-and-click game.
• The trackpad controls the cursor (you may want to adjust your sensitivity).
• The right trigger is your left click.
• The left trigger is your right click. 
• The pause and menu buttons work as expected. 

You can also touch the screen to click. It's a bit hard to select and combine items but it's doable.

We're still working on controller support. 
Hopefully, the next update will show the game as Supported on the Deck🤞

Calligram Studio

notes.title: Phoenix Springs is out on Monday!
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Just wanted to express our gratitude to everyone who played the preview. We’ve sensed some anticipation online, but as it stands, the late embargo means we have no idea how it will be received. Either way, it’s been a privilege to be the stewards of this world for the past seven years. It’s yours now.

A bit of housekeeping:

• I am currently pushing a [b]small update[/b] (navigation fixes, handful of typos that will haunt me for many nights to come, Kickstarter backers whose names have changed during development).

• A good question from The Verge about the [b]walkthrough/solution[/b]. Yes, it will be available in the public version. It links [url=https://www.calligramstudio.com/phoenix-springs-walkthrough/]to this page[/url], which is behind a soft paywall (email address). It’s designed to add a tiiiiny bit of friction before the spoilers and to replicate the experience of 90s hint lines. I suspect it might evolve as more guides become available online. 

[b]• Steam Achievements:[/b] there’s a lot of them! It’s a metagame designed for replayability. You’re unlikely to unlock more than a handful on your first playthrough, but I might go back to the drawing board depending on whether it’s playful or annoying.

• [b]Optimisation:[/b] the game runs great on all supported devices. It is, however, on the heavy side (5GB). The hand-drawn animations are mostly to blame. I’m confident we can do better, but I’m scared to break everything right now. This will be for a later update.

Thanks again for your time and patience. We hope you enjoy your travels through our labour of love/experiment.

Jigmé @Calligram Studio

A couple of weeks ago, a select few press outlets got their hands on the first act of Phoenix Springs. We’re extremely grateful to all the journalists who took the time to play and write about our little experiment.

Here is a selection of our favourite quotes:

[url=https://www.thegamer.com/phoenix-springs-preview/]TheGamer[/url]

notes.title: Phoenix Springs Wins Best Art Direction at IndieX Lisbon!
notes.notes:
Hi there,

over the past few months, we've been incredibly lucky to get to showcase the Phoenix Springs demo around the world. There was WASDxIGN in London, SXSW in Sydney, and IndieX in Lisbon.

[img]https://www.calligramstudio.com/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/All-Cons.png[/img]

It’s been a true privilege to chat with players, press, and fellow developers. Not only has the reception been fantastic, but we’re also pleased to announce that the last event culminated in us ]winning our first award for Best Art Direction!

[img]https://www.calligramstudio.com/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Screenshot_20231116_185039_com.brave.browser.jpg[/img]
[img]https://www.calligramstudio.com/content/images/size/w1600/2023/11/Indie-X-Award-Winner2023_ArtDirection-Black.png[/img]

The award is of course dedicated to the talented artists in the team, namely Eleanor for her illustrations and animations, Alex for his sound design, and Alexandra for her voice work. 

It's also a great time to thank [url=https://indiex.online/?ref=calligramstudio.com]IndieX [/url]and all of you for your continued support

[h2]What's Next?
[/h2]

We're back at work on the game, more or less full-time. Today, Alexandra delivered her ten-thousandth recorded word as Iris Dormer. Alex is mixing her lines as we speak. We also exported [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/R3xqDCm7Qfk]a timelapse of one of Eleanor's animations[/url]. It might give you an idea of the amount of work that goes into a one-second clip. 


[h2]Thank You[/h2]

As always, thanks for your support and patience as we continue crafting the game. And to answer the big question: still no release date, but it's coming :)

Best,

Calligram Studio

notes.title: Goodbye, Prologue/ Hello, Demo
notes.notes:
Important announcement!

We will shortly delete Phoenix Springs: Prologue from Steam.

Apologies for the change of heart – especially if you took the time to write a lovely review. 

We simply found that having a demo on the main page makes more sense. The Prologue and Demo are identical, so it was redundant and confusing. Hope it doesn't mess up your Steam libraries too much.

So this page will be your main destination for Phoenix Springs news from now on.

You can also subscribe to the newsletter on our website at [url=https://www.calligramstudio.com]calligramstudio.com[/url]

I will be answering any questions below if you have any.
We can't wait to let you into the world of Phoenix Springs.

Calligram Studio.
